note: City-board deck, the mission's balance reference. Sits on the 20-card floor for draw density: hand is 4 with a full recycle, so throughput is 4 cards/turn and the 5 seeded wild horses already inflate the pool to 25. All 30⚔️ of tame cost comes from Dogs — the whole goal is only 15🌾, so what is scarce is *drawing* 15 Dogs, not affording them. Two irrigated Farms fill City's 2 territory (3🌾/worker each), and Toolmaking covers the −1🔨 per untamed horse held; population never grows, because a Hut/House would cost one of the two Farm slots. Road is deliberately absent — Roads is a *sibling* branch off Writing, so it is not owned at this node (do not copy wheel.json's pool). Costs 25 of the 100 Influence guaranteed to have arrived here (farm ×2 = 1, four irrigation = 12, dogs ×8 = 7, foraging ×8 = 5).
